lookup.app: SELECT id FROM applications WHERE name = 'SMOKE 0925-233732 Scoped Reservations' AND status = 'active'
lookup.scope: SELECT s.id FROM application_scopes s JOIN locations l ON l.id = s.location_id WHERE s.application_id = 40 AND l.name = 'SMOKE 0925-233732 Downtown' AND s.removed_at IS NULL
lookup.who: SELECT id FROM members WHERE display_name = 'Priya Raman'

lookup.two: SELECT 'yes' FROM application_access ac WHERE ac.id = {{grant}} AND ac.role_key = 'manager' AND ac.capability = 'write' AND (SELECT count(*) FROM application_access_roles WHERE application_access_id = ac.id) = 2

shell: php -r 'require "app/bootstrap.php"; require "app/features/applications/sso.php"; $h = sso_member_holding(db(), {{app}}, {{who}}); foreach ($h["scopes"] as $s) if ($s["scope_id"] === {{scope}}) { echo implode(",", $s["roles"]), "\n"; exit(0); } exit(1);'

lookup.admin_now: SELECT 'yes' FROM application_access ac WHERE ac.id = {{changed}} AND ac.revoked_at IS NULL AND ac.role_key = 'admin' AND ac.capability = 'admin' AND (SELECT array_agg(role_key) FROM application_access_roles WHERE application_access_id = ac.id) = ARRAY['admin']

lookup.gone: SELECT 'yes' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM application_access WHERE application_id = {{app}} AND member_id = {{who}} AND scope_id = {{scope}} AND revoked_at IS NULL)
